advice_items.quote: There was nothing more important to me than being successful in accomplishing my goals... I was willing to sacrifice everything.
advice_items.summary_en: Commit completely to your goals and be willing to sacrifice and work as hard as needed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全力以赴并甘愿牺牲一切去达成目标

advice_items.quote: I found a problem that I wanted to solve that I was passionate about. I don't believe that you can just make money without passion.
advice_items.summary_en: Solve a problem you genuinely care about so passion keeps you going through inevitable hurdles.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做真正热爱的事业才能熬过艰难时刻

advice_items.quote: If you're not rested and wellfed, you're not going to work good... You need sleep.
advice_items.summary_en: Reject sleep-deprivation hustle myths; get 6–7 hours of sleep so your brain can execute sharply.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保证充足睡眠和精力才能高效工作

advice_items.quote: Yes, I want to have a great product, but if I don't have great service, it's not going to win. You got to have both combinations.
advice_items.summary_en: A great product alone isn't enough; pair it with superior customer service to beat competitors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 好产品必须配顶级服务才能胜出

advice_items.quote: Just because I've stayed focused. You got to be able to figure out what moves the needle.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay focused and identify the high-leverage drivers that actually move the needle.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注并识别真正推动增长的关键

advice_items.quote: Investing in the right team. You got to have a team. If you don't have a team, you got nothing. You can't do it all yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest heavily in an A-player team—even paying key staff more than yourself early on—to scale beyond yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重金投资顶尖团队并学会放权扩张

advice_items.quote: You got to bet on you. You got to believe in yourself. You got to never quit, no matter how dark it gets.
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself and refuse to quit through dark days regardless of self-doubt.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定押注自己，至暗时刻也绝不放弃

advice_items.quote: In order to be bankable, you need to have the right accounting. Your numbers have to be perfect cuz nobody's going to give you any money if they're not.
advice_items.summary_en: Hire a great accountant and keep spotless books so your business stays bankable and sellable.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持账目精准清晰，确保具备融资资质

advice_items.quote: The most successful people always look at life as if they are a student. I'm always trying to learn something new.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a lifelong student mindset; believing you know everything is when growth ends.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永远保持学徒心态，不断学习新事物

advice_items.quote: You have to count pennies and you have to really think with the details and you have to be willing to have the uncomfortable conversations. You have to be a shark.
advice_items.summary_en: Be shrewd about details, embrace uncomfortable conversations, and compete aggressively like a shark.
advice_items.summary_zh: 精明抠细节，敢于在商战中做鲨鱼

advice_items.quote: In order to be successful in life you have to be consistent on everything. So we've had to deliver over and over and over again all the time.
advice_items.summary_en: Outlast and overtake bigger incumbents through relentless daily consistency and zero-error delivery.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天稳定零失误交付，靠一致性胜出

advice_items.quote: If you're negotiating something, don't ever give them the first number. Make them make the offer.
advice_items.summary_en: Never name the first number in negotiations, and sell authentically rather than relying on gimmicks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判绝不先出价，销售靠真诚不靠套路

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: I want to show you how valuable I am... every day all I do is focus on value.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't chase or beg clients—focus daily on delivering undeniable value so prospects come to you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注创造自身价值，让客户主动选择你

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: You can never forget about what things cost in business cuz then you'll overspend.
advice_items.summary_en: No matter how wealthy you become, never lose sight of fair market value or overpay out of convenience.
advice_items.summary_zh: 时刻牢记事物真实成本，避免过度消费

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Don't Force Entrepreneurship Without the Stomach
advice_items.quote: Most people don't have the stomach for it, man. They really don't. You got to be willing to deal with everything. And if you're not, don't do it.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't pursue entrepreneurship unless you have the stomach to endure everything that comes with it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没有承受一切的心理素质就别创业

advice_items.quote: Spend the first 30 learning, spend the next 30 earning, and spend the last 30 giving.
advice_items.summary_en: Structure life across three 30-year chapters: learning first, earning second, and giving back third.
advice_items.summary_zh: 前30年学习，中30年赚钱，后30年回馈

advice_items.quote: I think be practical. A lot of times you get lost in the minutia of trying to be complicated.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay practical and keep business simple enough to calculate on a calculator and summarize in one paragraph.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持商业思维简单务实，别把事情搞复杂

advice_items.quote: You got to know the information, but then you got to know the right person to talk to... Invest in getting in front of the right people.
advice_items.summary_en: Pair domain knowledge with high-value relationships and actively invest in getting in the room with the right people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专业知识与人脉并重，主动靠近对的人

advice_items.quote: Buying a plane allowed me to get in front of bigger mentors that I wouldn't have been able to.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in yourself and create access to much bigger mentors whose knowledge cannot be taken from you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 舍得投资自己以换取顶级导师的人脉

advice_items.quote: Take a lot of risk, start a business, build it up, create an immense amount of cash flow and revenue.
advice_items.summary_en: Take big risks, launch a business, and consistently compound cash flow and revenue year over year.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于冒大风险创业，持续多年复利现金流

guests.first_money_or_break: 只有高中学历、在20多岁双亲因癌去世且刚经历离婚、带着两个年幼孩子并背负信用卡债务的困境下，于2012年在自家厨房穿着睡衣用一台苹果电脑创办Blackstone Medical Services；他通过向亲友筹资，每天发邮件联系医保公司谈合作、上门拜访医生拉业务，随后租下500美元月租的小办公室起步，最终在2019年订单量超越行业巨头成为全美第一。
guests.wealth_detail: $100M net worth (title); added ~$85M to net worth in 3-4 years; $5M+ private jet ($2M+/yr to operate)
guests.zero_start_advice: 从仅剩78美元的低谷翻身，第一步是真正下定决心并甘愿为成功牺牲一切（包括睡眠和时间）、绝不放弃；具体路径上要敢于冒大风险创业，打造能持续多年产生高额现金流和营收的实体生意，同时前30年专注学习、中间30年全力赚钱、最后30年回馈社会。
